method_challenges.description: Require independently receipted workforce, staffed-bed, scheduling, transfer, referral, and facility bottleneck evidence.

prohibited_claims: Do not calculate, score, rank, normalize, impute, or run Scale v1 or any sensitivity.

Do not average reviewer positions, adjudicate a conflict, fabricate human authority, project, promote, or deploy.
